questions.stem: A 70-year-old patient with a history of progressive vision loss is scheduled for cataract surgery under the National Program for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment. options.label: A
options.text: Patients requiring cataract surgeries are selected and asked to report to base hospital

options.label: B
options.text: Perform more small incision cataract surgery
